description: Twelve quarters of a small macroeconomy around the market, with a forced sale and leveraged investors in quarter 6. Rates are set by a Taylor rule (baseline) or by an AI central bank on Muse Spark or Spark Open. Market makers are scripted to isolate the central bank.

variants.name: ai_central_bank_spark
variants.label: AI central bank: Muse Spark
variants.change: A Muse Spark central bank sets the rate each quarter.

variants.name: ai_central_bank_open
variants.label: AI central bank: Spark Open
variants.change: A Muse Spark Open central bank sets the rate each quarter.
